items.summary: Percona Operator for PostgreSQL 3.1.0 takes on three things that decide whether a PostgreSQL platform passes review: is the data encrypted at rest, can it serve reads without straining the primary, and are the logs there when you need them. This release answers all three inside the custom resource, so none of them is a bolt-on you maintain yourself. The three headline features are transparent data encryption with pg_tde , logical replicas , and persistent logging . pg_tde encrypts your data on disk, including the write-ahead log. Logical replicas add a read-only copy inside the cluster for reporting and analytics. Persistent logging keeps Po…
